scope: Three original states: ticketmachine, ticketmachine_empty and ticketmachine_off (wallframe artwork). Source ready/empty differs in exactly two indicator pixels. Lower bracket remains present in all three states; it is not a removable paper ticket. Separate display enclosure, recessed display, dispenser with lined outlet, rear mounting rail and lower bracket. Queue_Number_Overlay_Slot preserves space for MAPTEXT(current_number); numbers are runtime-generated text, absent from atlas and intentionally not fabricated. Off is supplied atlas artwork, not asserted to be automatically selected by runtime power handling. Existing door_button assets cover remote control button; no duplicate button added.
